Marshmellow UI

No device connected

Connect your ZMK device to configure settings.

For USB, you should see 2 options with identical names, typically the first one is for ZMK Studio, and the second one is for Marshmellow UI and logs.

The device must be paired to be able to connect with Bluetooth.
Press "Start advertising" on your device to make it discoverable.

Tip

This app is fully contained within a single HTML file.
Save it with Ctrl+S and use offline at any time.
Browser compatibility
This application requires a Chromium-based browser for full functionality with Web Serial API. Please note that the Chromium itself is known for connecting successfully but then reading no data.

Known to work well:

  • Google Chrome
  • Vivaldi
